knowledge_gaps: Perturbations occur before truncation, so deleting recent interactions can expose older interactions absent from the original model input. Freeze the visible maxlen−1 history first, then perturb it; specify positional IDs and timestamp handling.

Reproduction requires explicit user/prefix selection, sample sizes, deletion sizes, swap positions, candidate counts, negative exclusions, tie handling, top-10 overlap definition, bootstrap settings, and score-parity tolerances. Keep candidate eligibility fixed across variants.

Training-prefix targets may already have influenced model fitting. These probes measure in-sample sensitivity; their relationship to validation HR@10 remains untested, and repeated diagnostic-guided selection can overfit validation.

The plan does not establish how diagnosis accesses exported-predictor scoring through the supplied interfaces. Mask assertions must follow the corrected baseline’s actual sampling policy, while evaluation state must be restored even after failures.

Originality 5/10 and potential 8/10 lack comparative evidence. Difficulty 3/10 may underestimate predictor integration, perturbation controls, uncertainty estimation, and runtime. Diagnostics are a reasonable first step, but do not yet justify recency-weighted training or demonstrate improved recommendation quality.
